title: Bounded same-key quaternion component-decode retention: prove lifecycle and complete charged cost before selecting an implementation

execution_source.publication_parent: The freshly observed enclosing C036 evidence head, on a new isolated branch

observed_basis.meaning: The scalar conversion is identical. Whole proof, subtraction, accumulation and source centers are not interchangeable. A repeated conversion is not itself a viable saving.

bounded_scope: Read the current live authority, ownership, C035/C036 evidence and exact source; reserve a new isolated documentation-only scope without advancing another owner or editing shared overviews.

Derive the actual lifetime and availability of the successful l1 decoder values, current-key comparison records and their seals; identify a generic source-based eligibility rule with no fixture/carrier/key predicate.

Determine whether an existing bounded same-key result record can retain detached completed component operands without a new persistent cache, source traversal, cross-clock state or resurrection after eviction.
Prove scalar-width and shape bounds from actual admitted native values, including ordinary binary64 and narrower-domain fallback; do not assume that all supplied values are binary32-derived.

Enumerate native dispatch/storage, typed value, source/context/owner, callback, cancellation, live domain and post-callback re-admission obligations. Preserve original exceptions and all surviving operation ordering.

Write a complete charge ledger for capture, storage/publication, lookup/scanning, admission, copies, reuse, retirement and every failed/unused reuse route. Include all added overhead; the identified occurrence saves at most one original decode charge before overhead.

Preserve fresh source-center subtraction, absolute error, l1 accumulation, radius arithmetic, sign selection and typed claim checks. Exact center differences cannot be ignored or converted to a new tolerance.

Obtain independent source/numerical/lifecycle/cost review and publish either a proved positive design or a clear no-go result. If overhead consumes savings, reject or hold the proposal. Implementation requires a separately selected bounded task.
deliverables: Source/control-flow derivation bound to exact files and candidate identity
Complete positive and fallback charge ledger
Independent review and explicit feasible/held/no-go decision
Next handoff without a product pass, saving or timing claim
excluded: Runtime, test, fixture, oracle, limit, tolerance, workflow or shared-overview edits
Executing a new candidate or relabeling C035/C036 evidence as validation of changed source
Profiler, trace hook, work callback, scalar wrapper or reader replacement
Whole quaternion proof sharing based on mirrored geometry, approximate centers or relaxed typed claims
New persistent cache, cross-clock component reuse, added source traversal or unbounded proof scanning
Resuming failed P11 or executing its unvisited tail with a fresh allowance
P16 retained clocks, P23 producer work, L03 reseeding or other separately owned scopes
Timing resampling or performance promotion of the held C035 product candidate
Other-owner branch updates, hosted/paid CI, main lease, force update or merge
acceptance_boundary: This is a source-only feasibility task. A negative cost/lifetime result completes the investigation. It does not pass P11, promote 4ca73909, replace accepted d2f0088c, change the 24/28 corpus result or close release gates.
